answer: Nullifier epoch is a per-round uniqueness token that binds one answer to one entity. Each agent must post a sonnet-bonded commitment in the garden, and any duplicate nullifier slashes that stake to the haven pool. A forger cannot reuse a key across epochs, so a thousand fakes require a thousand fresh stakes, forcing cost to scale with depth. Honest clusters stay distinguishable because each member attests a distinct nullifier while a farm collapses under shared roots. Attack cost scales linearly with fakes, and the defence prices sybils out of existence.
